reason: The README describes a dsh plugin whose primary purpose is providing agent web search through a configured SearXNG metasearch instance.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的 SearXNG 实例为智能体提供网页搜索能力。
summaries.en: Provides agent web search through a configured SearXNG metasearch instance.

capabilities: Registers a SearXNG-backed web search provider for the agent
Sends search requests to a configured HTTP(S) SearXNG instance
Supports optional authorization headers for the configured instance
